source_text: Psychologically, FGM in Sudan correlates with heightened anxiety and depression, with a study of 66 African immigrant women (including Sudanese) reporting 30% meeting criteria for anxiety disorders and 33% for depression, particularly among those with infibulation—a form dominant in Sudan—where vivid procedural memories predict worse outcomes (p < 0.05). [34]
